courses.title: 问候与自我介绍
courses.description: 从打招呼到介绍自己，掌握最基本的日常交际用语。

vocabularies.example_sentence: Hello, my name is Tom.
Good morning, everyone.
What is your name?
Nice to meet you, Amy.
This is my friend Jack.
Welcome to our school.

grammar_questions.stem: ___ name is Lily.
grammar_questions.explanation: 修饰名词 name 要用形容词性物主代词 My。

grammar_questions.stem: Hello! How ___ you today?
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语 you 与 be 动词搭配一律用 are。

grammar_questions.stem: Nice to ___ you.
grammar_questions.explanation: 不定式符号 to 后接动词原形，构成固定表达 Nice to meet you。

listening_materials.text: Hello! My name is Tom. What is your name?
listening_materials.translation: 你好！我叫汤姆。你叫什么名字？

listening_materials.text: Good morning, Miss Li. Nice to meet you.
listening_materials.translation: 早上好，李老师。很高兴认识你。

vocabularies.example_sentence: I am a student at No. 5 Middle School.
My mother is a teacher.
I come from Beijing.
I am twelve years old.
We are in the same class.
My hobby is reading books.

grammar_questions.stem: I ___ from Shanghai.
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语 I 与 be 动词搭配用 am。

grammar_questions.stem: She ___ a new student.
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 is。

grammar_questions.stem: My sister and I ___ in Class Two.
grammar_questions.explanation: 并列主语 My sister and I 是复数，be 动词用 are。

listening_materials.text: Hi, I am Lily. I am from China. I am thirteen years old.
listening_materials.translation: 嗨，我是莉莉。我来自中国。我十三岁。

listening_materials.text: This is my friend Jack. He is in my class.
listening_materials.translation: 这是我的朋友杰克。他在我的班里。

vocabularies.example_sentence: Where are you from?
I live in Guangzhou with my parents.
May I have your phone number?
My phone number is 12345678.
How old is your brother?
There are four people in my family.

grammar_questions.stem: — ___ do you live? — In Nanjing.
grammar_questions.explanation: 回答是地点 In Nanjing，提问地点用疑问词 Where。

grammar_questions.stem: — ___ is your sister? — She is ten.
grammar_questions.explanation: 回答是年龄，询问年龄用 How old。

grammar_questions.stem: There ___ three people in my family.
grammar_questions.explanation: there be 句型中 be 动词与后面的名词保持一致，three people 是复数，用 are。

listening_materials.text: Where do you live? I live in Guangzhou.
listening_materials.translation: 你住在哪里？我住在广州。

listening_materials.text: How old are you? I am twelve years old.
listening_materials.translation: 你多大了？我十二岁。

vocabularies.example_sentence: Goodbye! See you tomorrow.
Thanks for your help.
—Can you help me? —Sure.
I am sorry, I am late.
I will finish my homework tomorrow.
Can you help me with my homework?

grammar_questions.stem: — Thank you very much. — ___
grammar_questions.explanation: 回答对方的感谢用 You are welcome（不客气）。

grammar_questions.stem: It's late. ___ go home now.
grammar_questions.explanation: Let's 后接动词原形，表示提建议：让我们回家吧。

grammar_questions.stem: ___! The bus is coming.
grammar_questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，表示提醒或命令。

listening_materials.text: Goodbye, Tom! See you tomorrow.
listening_materials.translation: 再见，汤姆！明天见。

listening_materials.text: Thank you for your help. You are welcome.
listening_materials.translation: 谢谢你的帮助。不客气。

courses.title: 日常生活
courses.description: 围绕家庭、饮食、作息与购物，学会谈论日常生活。

vocabularies.example_sentence: My father is a doctor.
My mother cooks dinner every day.
My brother likes playing basketball.
My sister is only five years old.
The doctor works in a big hospital.
I like music very much.

grammar_questions.stem: My brother ___ sports after school.
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语 my brother 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s。

grammar_questions.stem: She ___ like coffee.
grammar_questions.explanation: 第三人称单数否定要借助 doesn't，后接动词原形 like。

grammar_questions.stem: ___ your father a doctor?
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语 your father 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 Is 并提前构成一般疑问句。

listening_materials.text: My mother is a teacher and my father is a doctor.
listening_materials.translation: 我妈妈是老师，我爸爸是医生。

listening_materials.text: I have one brother and two sisters.
listening_materials.translation: 我有一个哥哥和两个妹妹。

vocabularies.example_sentence: I would like some rice and fish.
I have bread and milk for breakfast.
She eats an egg every morning.
Can I have a glass of water?
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
I am hungry. Let's eat lunch.

grammar_questions.stem: I want ___ apple, please.
grammar_questions.explanation: apple 以元音音素开头，表示“一个”要用冠词 an。

grammar_questions.stem: There ___ some milk in the glass.
grammar_questions.explanation: milk 是不可数名词，there be 句型中用 is。

grammar_questions.stem: How ___ bread do you want?
grammar_questions.explanation: bread 是不可数名词，提问数量用 How much。

listening_materials.text: I am hungry. I would like some bread and milk.
listening_materials.translation: 我饿了。我想要一些面包和牛奶。

listening_materials.text: Can I have a glass of water, please?
listening_materials.translation: 请给我一杯水好吗？

vocabularies.example_sentence: I have breakfast at seven thirty.
I usually go to school by bus.
I get up early every day.
We do homework in the evening.
The class begins at eight o'clock.
I visit my grandparents on weekends.

grammar_questions.stem: He ___ gets up at six.
grammar_questions.explanation: 修饰动词 gets up 要用频率副词 usually。

grammar_questions.stem: I go to school ___ seven o'clock.
grammar_questions.explanation: 具体时刻前用介词 at。

grammar_questions.stem: She ___ to bed at ten every night.
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词 go 变 goes。

listening_materials.text: I usually get up at six thirty and have breakfast at seven.
listening_materials.translation: 我通常六点半起床，七点吃早餐。

listening_materials.text: We play football on weekends.
listening_materials.translation: 我们周末踢足球。

vocabularies.example_sentence: I want to buy a new schoolbag.
This pen is cheap but nice.
That coat is too expensive for me.
There is a shop near my home.
Mother buys clothes for me.
How much is this T-shirt?

grammar_questions.stem: How ___ is this dictionary?
grammar_questions.explanation: 询问价格用 How much。

grammar_questions.stem: This shirt is ___ cheaper than that one.
grammar_questions.explanation: 比较级 cheaper 前可用 much 加强程度，意为“……得多”。

grammar_questions.stem: I want ___ a book about animals.
grammar_questions.explanation: want 后接不定式 to do，表示想要做某事。

listening_materials.text: How much is this hat? It is twenty yuan.
listening_materials.translation: 这顶帽子多少钱？二十元。

listening_materials.text: These shoes are too expensive. I want to buy a cheap pair.
listening_materials.translation: 这双鞋太贵了。我想买一双便宜的。

courses.title: 旅行与工作
courses.description: 在机场、酒店与职场情境中提升综合表达能力。

vocabularies.example_sentence: Our flight to London takes off at nine.
Please show me your passport.
I have two pieces of luggage.
Passengers can board the plane at Gate 5.
The heavy fog delayed our flight.
We will arrive in Paris at noon.

grammar_questions.stem: The plane ___ off ten minutes ago.
grammar_questions.explanation: 与表示过去的时间状语 ten minutes ago 连用，用一般过去时 took。

grammar_questions.stem: I ___ my passport yet.
grammar_questions.explanation: 与 yet 连用表示到目前为止的结果，用现在完成时 haven't found。

grammar_questions.stem: We look forward to ___ from you soon.
grammar_questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词 hearing。

listening_materials.text: Excuse me, when does Flight CA985 board?
listening_materials.translation: 打扰一下，CA985 航班什么时候登机？

listening_materials.text: Our flight was delayed for two hours because of the storm.
listening_materials.translation: 由于暴风雨，我们的航班延误了两个小时。

vocabularies.example_sentence: I have reserved a double room for three nights.
Please leave your key at the reception.
Is there a single room available tonight?
The hotel has excellent sports facilities.
We check out before twelve at noon.
Take the lift to the tenth floor.

grammar_questions.stem: A room ___ the sea costs more.
grammar_questions.explanation: 现在分词 facing 作后置定语，表示主动关系“朝向大海的房间”。

grammar_questions.stem: By the time we arrived, the hotel ___ full.
grammar_questions.explanation: 到达之前酒店已经住满，“过去的过去”用过去完成时 had been。

grammar_questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ the lift is?
grammar_questions.explanation: 宾语从句询问地点，用连接副词 where 引导。

listening_materials.text: I would like to check in. I have reserved a double room.
listening_materials.translation: 我想办理入住。我预订了一间双人房。

listening_materials.text: Breakfast is served from seven to ten in the dining hall.
listening_materials.translation: 早餐七点到十点在餐厅供应。

vocabularies.example_sentence: She performed well in the job interview.
He has five years of teaching experience.
I am applying for the position of engineer.
You can apply for the job online.
Answer the questions with confidence.
They offered him a higher salary.

grammar_questions.stem: She ___ in this company since 2019.
grammar_questions.explanation: 与 since 引导的时间连用，表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

grammar_questions.stem: He is used to ___ under pressure.
grammar_questions.explanation: be used to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词 working，表示习惯于做某事。

grammar_questions.stem: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
grammar_questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，be 动词一律用 were。

listening_materials.text: Thank you for coming. Please tell me about your work experience.
listening_materials.translation: 谢谢你前来面试。请谈谈你的工作经历。

listening_materials.text: I have applied for the position of sales manager.
listening_materials.translation: 我申请了销售经理的职位。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The weekly meeting starts at nine sharp.
Could we schedule a call for Friday?
My colleagues are very supportive.
We must finish the report before the deadline.
She was promoted to team leader last month.
All staff must attend the training.

grammar_questions.stem: The report ___ by the whole team yesterday.
grammar_questions.explanation: 报告是“被写”的，与 yesterday 连用，用一般过去时的被动语态 was written。

grammar_questions.stem: He suggested ___ the meeting until Monday.
grammar_questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词作宾语，即 suggest doing sth。

grammar_questions.stem: This is the manager ___ joined us last month.
grammar_questions.explanation: 先行词 manager 指人，且在定语从句中作主语，用关系代词 who。

listening_materials.text: Could we reschedule the meeting to three o'clock this afternoon?
listening_materials.translation: 我们能把会议改到今天下午三点吗？

listening_materials.text: Please send me the report before the deadline on Friday.
listening_materials.translation: 请在周五截止日期前把报告发给我。

courses.title: 观点表达
courses.description: 学会表达偏好、赞成与反对、讲述经历并提出建议。

vocabularies.example_sentence: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
I really enjoy hiking in the mountains.
In my opinion, the film is worth watching.
Everyone has his own taste in music.
Swimming is my favorite sport.
She is keen on photography.

grammar_questions.stem: I would rather ___ at home tonight.
grammar_questions.explanation: would rather 后接动词原形，表示宁愿做某事。

grammar_questions.stem: He is fond of ___ old coins.
grammar_questions.explanation: 介词 of 后接动名词 collecting 作宾语。

grammar_questions.stem: Neither of the two films ___ interesting.
grammar_questions.explanation: neither 作主语时谓语动词用单数形式。

listening_materials.text: To be honest, I prefer reading at home to going out.
listening_materials.translation: 说实话，比起出门我更喜欢在家读书。

listening_materials.text: In my opinion, this is the best restaurant in town.
listening_materials.translation: 在我看来，这是镇上最好的餐厅。

vocabularies.example_sentence: I couldn't agree with you more.
I'm afraid I disagree with that idea.
You have a point, but it costs too much.
Her argument sounds convincing.
He convinced me to change my plan.
Honestly, I don't think it will work.

grammar_questions.stem: Not only I but also my parents ___ the plan.
grammar_questions.explanation: not only...but also 连接主语时，谓语与最近的主语 my parents 保持一致，用复数。

grammar_questions.stem: I don't think he ___ right.
grammar_questions.explanation: think 引导的宾语从句否定前移，从句本身用肯定形式 is。

grammar_questions.stem: ___ the cost is high, many people still support the project.
grammar_questions.explanation: 前后语义转折，用 Although 引导让步状语从句。

listening_materials.text: That's a good point, but I still think the price is too high.
listening_materials.translation: 这话有道理，但我还是觉得价格太高。

listening_materials.text: I'm afraid I have to disagree with you on this issue.
listening_materials.translation: 恐怕在这个问题上我不同意你的看法。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The journey across the desert was unforgettable.
It was an unforgettable summer for me.
I worked as a volunteer at the school.
Learning a new language is a big challenge.
She overcame her fear of speaking in public.
The old photos brought back sweet memories.

grammar_questions.stem: I ___ in Africa when I was young.
grammar_questions.explanation: when I was young 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时 lived。

grammar_questions.stem: By the age of twenty, he ___ three countries.
grammar_questions.explanation: by the age of twenty 表示到过去某时为止，用过去完成时 had visited。

grammar_questions.stem: This is the most exciting trip that I ___ taken.
grammar_questions.explanation: “这是（至今）最……的经历”用现在完成时，主语 I 配 have。

listening_materials.text: Last summer I volunteered in a village school for a month.
listening_materials.translation: 去年夏天我在一所乡村学校做了一个月志愿者。

listening_materials.text: It was a wonderful journey and I made many new friends.
listening_materials.translation: 那是一次美妙的旅程，我结识了许多新朋友。

vocabularies.example_sentence: I suggest starting the project earlier.
She gave me some useful advice.
Can you recommend a good hotel nearby?
You should consider his suggestion seriously.
The museum is worth a visit.
Let's walk there instead of taking a bus.

grammar_questions.stem: The teacher suggested that he ___ more careful.
grammar_questions.explanation: suggest 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气，即 (should) + 动词原形 be。

grammar_questions.stem: It is no use ___ about the weather.
grammar_questions.explanation: 固定句型 It is no use doing sth，表示“做某事没有用”。

grammar_questions.stem: You had better ___ a taxi, or you'll be late.
grammar_questions.explanation: had better 后接动词原形，表示最好做某事。

listening_materials.text: If I were you, I would take his advice and start early.
listening_materials.translation: 如果我是你，我会听取他的建议早点出发。

listening_materials.text: Why not join us? The more, the merrier.
listening_materials.translation: 为什么不加入我们呢？人越多越开心。

courses.title: 新闻时事
courses.description: 通过环境、科技、经济与社会议题，掌握高级新闻词汇与复杂句式。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The government aims to cut carbon emissions by half.
Solar power is a clean and renewable source of energy.
Sustainability should be at the heart of urban planning.
Deforestation poses a serious threat to biodiversity.
The worst drought in decades hit the region last year.
Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of climate change.

grammar_questions.stem: Had the government acted earlier, the crisis ___ less severe.
grammar_questions.explanation: 省略 if 的虚拟条件句表示与过去事实相反，主句用 would have been。

grammar_questions.stem: It is high time that we ___ fossil fuels.
grammar_questions.explanation: It is high time that 后接一般过去式，表示“该是……的时候了”。

grammar_questions.stem: Rarely ___ such rapid warming of the oceans.
grammar_questions.explanation: 否定意义副词 rarely 位于句首时，句子用部分倒装 have we seen。

listening_materials.text: Carbon emissions must fall sharply if we are to avoid the worst effects of climate change.
listening_materials.translation: 如果我们要避免气候变化带来的最坏影响，碳排放必须大幅下降。

listening_materials.text: The government has pledged to invest more in renewable energy.
listening_materials.translation: 政府已承诺加大对可再生能源的投资。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The algorithm behind the search engine is highly complex.
Robots now automate many tasks on the production line.
Technological innovation drives economic growth.
The app was criticized for invading users' privacy.
Scientists announced a major breakthrough in gene editing.
Widespread surveillance raises serious ethical questions.

grammar_questions.stem: ___ with a difficult problem, the engineer turned to his AI assistant.
grammar_questions.explanation: be faced with 表示“面临”，作状语时用过去分词 Faced。

grammar_questions.stem: The information ___ by millions of devices every day.
grammar_questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词且与 collect 是被动关系，用一般现在时被动 is collected。

grammar_questions.stem: ___ matters most is how humans adapt to the new technology.
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语从句中缺少主语，指代“最重要的东西”，用 What 引导。

listening_materials.text: Artificial intelligence is transforming the way we work and live.
listening_materials.translation: 人工智能正在改变我们工作和生活的方式。

listening_materials.text: Experts warn that new technologies must be regulated to protect personal privacy.
listening_materials.translation: 专家警告说，必须对新技术加以监管以保护个人隐私。

vocabularies.example_sentence: Inflation climbed to its highest level in a decade.
The country slid into a deep recession last year.
Foreign investment in the region has doubled.
Consumers are spending less on luxury goods.
Oil prices continued to fluctuate sharply.
The central bank announced a new stimulus package.

grammar_questions.stem: Hardly ___ when prices began to rise.
options: the stimulus package had been announced
had the stimulus package been announced
the stimulus package has been announced
grammar_questions.explanation: Hardly...when 句型中 Hardly 置于句首引起部分倒装，且用过去完成时被动。

grammar_questions.stem: The company denied ___ false figures to its investors.
grammar_questions.explanation: deny 后接动名词作宾语，即 deny doing sth。

grammar_questions.stem: Should the crisis deepen, the bank ___ interest rates.
grammar_questions.explanation: Should the crisis deepen 是省略 if 的虚拟条件句，主句用 would cut。

listening_materials.text: Global markets tumbled as inflation hit its highest level in decades.
listening_materials.translation: 随着通货膨胀达到数十年来最高水平，全球市场大幅下挫。

listening_materials.text: The central bank raised interest rates again in an effort to curb inflation.
listening_materials.translation: 央行再次加息以遏制通货膨胀。

vocabularies.example_sentence: Education remains a key to reducing social inequality.
The law forbids discrimination on the basis of age.
Millions of children still live in extreme poverty.
New policies help immigrants integrate into society.
Many experts advocate a shorter working week.
The welfare system supports those most in need.

grammar_questions.stem: It is essential that every citizen ___ equal access to education.
grammar_questions.explanation: It is essential that 后的从句用虚拟语气 (should) have。

grammar_questions.stem: Only when poverty is eliminated ___ true social justice.
grammar_questions.explanation: only 修饰的状语从句位于句首时，主句用部分倒装 can we achieve。

grammar_questions.stem: The report highlights the fact ___ inequality is widening.
grammar_questions.explanation: fact 后接同位语从句，说明 fact 的具体内容，用连接词 that。

listening_materials.text: Closing the gap between rich and poor remains one of society's greatest challenges.
listening_materials.translation: 缩小贫富差距仍然是社会面临的最大挑战之一。

listening_materials.text: Activists are calling for stronger laws against workplace discrimination.
listening_materials.translation: 活动人士呼吁制定更严格的法律来反对职场歧视。

courses.title: 学术讨论
courses.description: 从研究方法到学术写作，构建正式场合的分析与论证能力。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The experiment was designed to test our hypothesis.
The paper describes the methodology in detail.
The survey drew a sample of two thousand adults.
Researchers controlled for every major variable.
The team will analyze the data using statistical software.
A larger sample improves the validity of the results.

grammar_questions.stem: The findings ___ that further research is needed.
grammar_questions.explanation: findings 意为“研究结果”，是复数名词，谓语动词用原形 suggest。

grammar_questions.stem: ___ the results are reliable remains to be seen.
grammar_questions.explanation: 主语从句表示“是否可靠尚待观察”，用 Whether 引导。

grammar_questions.stem: A survey ___ last year involved over five hundred students.
grammar_questions.explanation: survey 与 conduct 是被动关系，用过去分词 conducted 作后置定语。

listening_materials.text: This study sets out to test the hypothesis that sleep affects memory.
listening_materials.translation: 本研究旨在验证睡眠影响记忆这一假设。

listening_materials.text: The methodology section explains how the data were collected and analyzed.
listening_materials.translation: 研究方法部分解释了数据是如何收集和分析的。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The argument rests on a questionable premise.
Readers should be aware of the author's potential bias.
The conclusion is not supported by sufficient evidence.
The scholar refuted the claims with solid data.
Considering the issue from another perspective helps.
His argument is built on a false assumption.

grammar_questions.stem: ___ the author's claims, the data point in the opposite direction.
grammar_questions.explanation: 与作者的说法相反，用短语 Contrary to 引出对比。

grammar_questions.stem: ___, the two studies reached opposite conclusions.
grammar_questions.explanation: 修饰整个句子要用评注性副词 Interestingly。

grammar_questions.stem: It was the sample size ___ made the results questionable.
grammar_questions.explanation: 强调句型 It was...that...，被强调部分是物也用 that。

listening_materials.text: A strong argument must rest on solid evidence rather than opinion.
listening_materials.translation: 一个有力的论证必须建立在可靠证据而非观点之上。

listening_materials.text: We should question the assumptions behind any research finding.
listening_materials.translation: 我们应当质疑任何研究结论背后的假设。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The graph shows sharp fluctuations in demand.
Sales reached their peak in December.
There was a steady decline in unemployment.
A large proportion of respondents were students.
Women account for sixty percent of the workforce.
The overall trend suggests a gradual recovery.

grammar_questions.stem: The number of students ___ sharply since 2020.
grammar_questions.explanation: the number of 作主语谓语用单数；与 since 连用且“上升”为不及物动词，用 has risen。

grammar_questions.stem: Sales doubled, ___ surprised many analysts.
grammar_questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指代前面整个句子，用关系代词 which。

grammar_questions.stem: By 2030, the proportion of elderly people ___ to thirty percent.
grammar_questions.explanation: by + 将来时间表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时 will have risen。

listening_materials.text: As the chart shows, the number of online learners doubled between 2020 and 2025.
listening_materials.translation: 如图所示，在线学习者的数量在2020年至2025年间翻了一番。

listening_materials.text: The figures reveal a steady upward trend in household spending.
listening_materials.translation: 数据显示家庭支出呈稳步上升趋势。

vocabularies.example_sentence: The author cites several recent studies to support her claim.
All references must follow the required format.
You may paraphrase the passage in your own words.
A coherent essay develops one clear line of thought.
Plagiarism can lead to serious academic consequences.
The abstract summarizes the aims and findings of the paper.

grammar_questions.stem: Not until the final draft was completed ___ the full references.
grammar_questions.explanation: Not until 位于句首时主句用部分倒装 did the student add。

grammar_questions.stem: The editor recommended that the abstract ___ rewritten.
grammar_questions.explanation: recommend 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气 (should) be rewritten。

grammar_questions.stem: ___ cited properly, the source may still be considered plagiarism.
grammar_questions.explanation: If not cited properly 是“if + 否定 + 过去分词”的条件状语，表示“如果不正确引用”。

listening_materials.text: Remember to cite every source you use; otherwise, it counts as plagiarism.
listening_materials.translation: 记得标注所有引用来源，否则即视为剽窃。

listening_materials.text: A good academic essay presents a clear argument in coherent paragraphs.
listening_materials.translation: 一篇优秀的学术文章以连贯的段落呈现清晰的论证。

placement_questions.explanation: 早晨见面问候用 Good morning，回应同样的问候。
主语 she 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 is。

placement_questions.stem: There ___ two books on the desk.
placement_questions.explanation: there be 句型遵循就近原则，two books 是复数，用 are。

placement_questions.stem: I ___ my keys, so I can't open the door.
placement_questions.explanation: 过去的动作对现在造成影响（开不了门），用现在完成时 have lost。
桥是“被建”的，与过去时间 2020 连用，用一般过去时被动语态 was built。

placement_questions.stem: Do you know the woman ___ is talking to Tom?
placement_questions.explanation: 先行词 the woman 指人，且在定语从句中作主语，用关系代词 who。

placement_questions.stem: If I ___ you, I would take the chance.
placement_questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，be 动词一律用 were。

placement_questions.stem: Never in my life ___ such a moving film.
placement_questions.explanation: 否定副词 Never 位于句首，句子用部分倒装 have I seen。

placement_questions.stem: It is necessary that each member ___ the rules.
placement_questions.explanation: It is necessary that 后的从句用虚拟语气 (should) follow。
